rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: The Hudu integration enables AI assistants to interact with the Hudu IT documentation platform. It exposes 39 tools for managing companies, assets, configurations, knowledge base articles, passwords, websites, and procedures, along with 6 resources for direct data access. Built by WYRE Technology, the server supports stdio and HTTP transports, Docker deployment, and DigitalOcean and Cloudflare Workers one-click deployment.
